issue.title: .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md (Copilot harness) missing the project-board-update step present in the canonical .claude/agents/ file

task: Fix the discrepancy between .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md and .claude/agents/doc-updater.md - the GitHub harness version is missing the project-board-update step

evidence: Confirmed pre-existing GH-750 / ISS-0690 records (filed 2026-08-12T17:41:57Z) — not a new issue, no re-filing needed.
Verified .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md's GitHub Branch Management section had 5 steps; .claude/agents/doc-updater.md had 7 steps — numbering and contents diverged at step 5.
Step 5 in the canonical file ('If this run resolves a GitHub issue, update the project board per docs/agents/protocols/PROJECT_BOARD.md ...') was entirely absent from the Copilot mirror.
grep -c 'gh_project_status' on .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md returned 0 before the fix; returns 4 after.
grep -c 'PROJECT_BOARD' on .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md returned 0 before the fix; returns 1 after.

fix.description: Inserted canonical step 5 (project-board update) into .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md between the existing Verify cleanup (now step 4) and the requirement-tracking-issue step (now step 6). Renumbered the in-file 'Record in handoff result' from step 6 to step 7. The inserted step 5 is byte-identical to .claude/agents/doc-updater.md's step 5 (814 chars, verified).
fix.commit_message: fix(doc-updater): mirror project-board-update step to Copilot harness (GH-750, ISS-0690)
fix.rebase_note: Pushed via rebase onto origin/main (commit hash changed 10f0a7ae -> 06c71d5d because a batch-claim commit 2c7046e1 landed on origin/main between commit and push; diff content identical).

out_of_scope_notes: Pre-existing sister drift in step 6 (requirement-tracking-issue close) prose: the canonical file has longer explanations (mentions DDL-05/MIG-01/PIN-04, the wf02-batch-5 retrospective, the longer 'gh issue list --search' caveat, and the longer 'TESTED held-back' wording). The Copilot mirror retains its shorter pre-2026-08-12 wording. GH-750's explicit scope is only the project-board step, so this sister drift is intentionally left for a follow-up ISS.
The structural problem (these Copilot-mirror files being full independent copies rather than thin pointers) is also pre-existing and out of scope.

result.summary: Fixed Category A (adapter drift) in .github/agents/doc-updater.agent.md: inserted the canonical project-board-update step 5 (byte-identical to .claude/agents/doc-updater.md, 814 chars), renumbered the requirement-tracking-issue step 5→6 and the record-in-handoff step 6→7. Committed to main and pushed to origin/main as 06c71d5d (was 10f0a7ae before rebase; rebased onto a batch-claim commit that landed on origin/main during this run). Local ISS-0690/GH-750 marked RESOLVED. Cross-harness step numbering 1–7 now matches. Lint_handoffs.py: 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 MINOR (pre-existing), 291 ACKNOWLEDGED — exit 0.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-03 Step 3) — no source code changed, no executable test required; recommend proceeding to doc-updater (WF-03 Step Final) for changelog entry and GH-750 close comment.
